_notes: 402 keys had no Indonesian (cur = null); all are translated here. Product names mobile:app.agency / mobile:app.university stay 'Hangyul Agency' / 'Hangyul University' (English product names, as the Student app keeps 'Hangyul Univ').
Register: v17 gate/pay strings and v18.offline used 'kamu'; the whole file is 'Anda', so they were aligned. 'HP' was aligned to 'ponsel' (already the dominant term).

'Konselor Anda' appeared in ~15 student-facing strings where the English says 'the Hangyul team'; aligned to 'tim Hangyul' / 'tim Hangyul Univ'. 'Konselor' is kept only in staff-facing agency/university strings where the English says counselor.

Personal statement: the id locale already uses 'pernyataan pribadi' in most places (two stray 'personal statement' / 'esai pribadi' in other namespaces, outside this job); kept 'pernyataan pribadi' and used it for the previously untranslated plan allowance rows. Owner may prefer the English loanword 'personal statement', which Indonesian applicants commonly use (LPDP etc.).

Plan = 'paket' (existing convention; 'paket layanan' when it stands alone). 'Pilihan bantuan' / 'paket dukungan' were aligned to it. Upgrade = 'upgrade' (loanword already used in v29 copy), so v17.upgrade.cta moved from 'Pindah ke' to 'Upgrade ke'.

Visa: 'persiapan visa' (student:v15 scope, v17 gate) reads as 'we prepare your visa'; rendered 'persiapan dokumen visa' per the glossary. 'Mengurus visa' in the visa stage line became 'Menyiapkan visa'.

Official names: 'surat penerimaan standar' wherever the English says standard admission letter (v22 appTeam.letter, OFFER_ACCEPTED body); 'legalisasi konsuler' where the English says consular legalization (docAction.LEGALIZE, university.documentsCount, v4 nextLegalize); 'notarisasi' instead of 'legalisasi notaris' in the exclusions line; 'transkrip nilai' for transcript.

'Terverifikasi'/'memverifikasi' in student copy (documents.legal.intro, v3.documents.legalize) became 'memeriksa'/'sudah diperiksa': the glossary reserves verification for official verification; agency 'Verifikasi dokumen' (the staff action) is kept, matching the agency console.

First-response / review 'promise' (agency): rendered 'janji respons pertama' / 'janji tinjauan' to follow the English reference; the id agency web console says 'SLA respons pertama'. Owner's call whether the mobile agency app should say SLA like the console.

Consent (student:register.consent.* and mobile:signup.consent.*): the current Indonesian carried extra legal detail ('item yang ditransfer, waktu, masa penyimpanan', 'verifikasi identitas', 'hash kata sandi') that the reviewed English does not; both apps now carry the same wording as the English. Because these are consent texts, the owner should confirm the shortened wording with whoever owns the Korean privacy notice.
mobile:login.networkError dropped the Android-emulator / LAN-IP developer instructions that the English no longer has.

mobile:v3.uni.view.enrolment 'Visa & enrollment' is rendered 'Visa & daftar ulang' (enrollment at an Indonesian/Korean university = daftar ulang); the id university console uses 'Terdaftar' for the Enrolled state, which is kept for step.ENROLLED.

Plural _one forms in Indonesian carry {{count}} and are identical to _other (no plural marking); agency/uni count-less _one/_other pairs (e.g. att.closing, decision.*) read correctly without a number.
